summary: Form-associated text field with a comet of light on the border while focused; invalid values turn the border to static.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label, linked to the inner input. Hidden when absent.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial value, also restored on form reset. Not observed; use the `value` property to change the text.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Text under the field when there is no error.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Message shown, and used as the validation message, when the value is invalid. Defaults to the browser `validationMessage`.

attributes.name: success
attributes.description: Message shown when a valid value is committed on blur. Falls back to `hint`.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Passed to the inner `<input>`, for example `email`, `url` or `password`.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Presence attribute, passed to the inner input.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Presence attribute. Disables the inner input; a disabled ancestor `<fieldset>` does the same. A disabled field is not submitted.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the inner input commits a change, on blur after editing.

methods.description: Moves focus to the inner input.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current text. Setting it updates the form value and validity, but not the visual state or message.

accessibility: A `<label for>` in the shadow root names the inner `<input>`.
The hint, error and success text sits in an `aria-live="polite"` region that also describes the input (`aria-describedby`).
Sets `aria-invalid` on the inner input when it validates on blur; form reset removes it.
The host does not delegate focus; call `focus()` on it to focus the input.
motion: With reduced motion the border comet stays in one place, the error static does not flicker, the caret sparks and error shake are skipped, and messages swap without rolling.
form: Submits the inner input value under `name`. Validity mirrors the inner input constraints (`required`, `type`, `pattern`, `minlength`, `maxlength`) and reports `customError` with the `error` text or the browser message. The error or success state appears on blur, and while in error it re-checks on every edit. Form reset restores the `value` attribute, the hint and the neutral state. A disabled field is not submitted.
notes: `value` is read on first connect only; the other attributes are observed and passed to the inner input when they change.
The inner input's native `input` event stops at the shadow root; listen to the host's `input` event, whose `detail` carries the value.
